items.title: CVE-2024-0264: SourceCodester Clinic Queuing System authorization bypass in LoginRegistration.php formToken (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the SourceCodester Clinic Queuing System lets an attacker bypass authorization through the formToken argument of its LoginRegistration.php file. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, and public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-113425: F5 NGINX Plus memory corruption in mail proxy module (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source, when configured as a mail proxy, contain a use-after-free bug that a remote attacker can trigger over the network without logging in. Successful exploitation may crash an nginx worker process or corrupt its memory, disrupting service, and remote code execution is a potential impact.

items.title: CVE-2026-123634: F5 NGINX Plus remote code execution in resolver via use-after-free (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source are affected when configured as a proxy with variables in the proxied server name and an SSI or mirror directive that sends a subrequest to a location resolving that same name. A remote attacker, without logging in, can send a specially crafted HTTP request to crash a worker process, corrupt its memory, or potentially execute code.

items.title: CVE-2026-12507: Zoho remote code execution via SQL injection in Reports module (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Zohocorp AssetExplorer, ServiceDesk Plus, ServiceDesk Plus MSP, and SupportCenter Plus contain a flaw in the Reports module that lets an attacker run arbitrary commands on the underlying server. The attacker reaches it over the network with a high-privilege login, specifically an account that has the Create Query Reports permission, by sending specially crafted database queries.

items.title: CVE-2026-114938: Oracle Java SE remote takeover via heap overflow in compiler (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, and Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition contain a flaw in the Compiler component. A remote attacker with no credentials can reach it over the network by supplying crafted data to an API, such as through a web service; the attacker can overwrite heap memory, read it to leak sensitive data, and potentially achieve remote code execution, though the flaw is har...

items.title: CVE-2026-134651
items.summary: A flaw was found in Quay. This vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker holding a restricted, short-lived JSON Web Token (JWT) to achieve privilege escalation. Because Quay improperly accepts scoped registry bearer tokens as valid robot account passwords, an attacker can authenticate directly as the robot account and obtain broader permissions. Consequently, unauthorized access persists and enables the attacker to generate fresh tokens even after the robot account's password has been reset.

items.title: CVE-2026-127024
items.summary: The WordForm WordPress plugin before 4.1.6 does not properly validate uploaded files, allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files, including PHP, which leads to remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-123136
items.summary: The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.2 does not check that the ticket type and price chosen through one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions belong to the event ticket later added to the cart, and stores them site-wide, allowing unauthenticated visitors to buy an event ticket at the lower ticket-type price configured on a different event.

items.title: CVE-2026-134679
items.summary: WeddingShare through 1.8.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the anonymous MediaViewerController.GalleryItem action that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve item upload paths without the gallery secret key. Attackers can enumerate sequential integer item ids to learn paths and uploader names, then download photos and videos from key-protected galleries served as static files.

items.title: CVE-2026-134654
items.summary: Mailflare before 48957fb contains a host header injection vulnerability in the password-reset request handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to poison reset links when APP_URL is unset. Attackers can submit a reset request for a victim's email with a malicious Host header, capturing the single-use token when the victim clicks the link to take over the account.

items.title: CVE-2026-132814
items.summary: The WPO365 | SEAMLESS WORDPRESS + MICROSOFT INTEGRATION (WPO365 | LOGIN) WordPress plugin before 45.0 does not verify that a Microsoft ID token was issued for the site's own application and tenant when multi-tenant sign-in is enabled with an empty list of allowed tenants, allowing unauthenticated attackers to log in as an existing user, including an administrator, with a token Microsoft issued to an application they control.

items.title: CVE-2026-123068
items.summary: The Front User Submit WordPress plugin before 5.1.0 does not validate the content of files uploaded through one of its unauthenticated endpoints and later serves them back with a Content-Type derived from the file's bytes and an inline disposition, allowing unauthenticated attackers to store an HTML or SVG payload and obtain a same-origin URL that executes arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of any user who opens it, including an administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-120413
items.summary: The Yoast SEO WordPress plugin before 28.9 does not check that content is publicly viewable before returning its SEO metadata through a public REST endpoint, allowing unauthenticated users who know or can guess the URL of a private post, page or custom post type item to read its title, author, publication date and an excerpt of its content.

items.title: CVE-2026-134451
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows non-admin users with settings:edit permission to modify OIDC provider configuration due to an improper permission check. Attackers can send a PUT request to /api/auth/oidc/ setting adminClaim to their own OIDC group, gaining full admin access on their next OIDC login.

items.title: CVE-2026-125294

This is due to a byte-level denylist on the `tpgb_acf_key[]` and `tpgb_acf[]` parameters that fails to block Unicode look-alike characters — such as U+1E87 and U+00E7 in a key like `ẇp_çapabilities` — whose UTF-8 byte sequences do not match any ASCII-based pattern check, while the database's default accent-insensitive collation (`utf8mb4_unicode_ci` / `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci`) treats the decorated key as equivalent to the canoni…

items.title: CVE-2026-134461
items.summary: Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.10, 4.0.0 before 4.0.7, and 4.1.0 before 4.1.7 contain an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in PBES2AESKW::unwrapKey(), which passes the attacker-controlled p2c JWE header value to hash_pbkdf2() without an upper bound. Unauthenticated attackers can send a JWE using a PBES2-HS*+A*KW algorithm with a huge p2c iteration count to force lengthy PBKDF2 computations and exhaust server CPU.

items.title: CVE-2026-134352
items.summary: Rclone from 1.51.0 before 1.76.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in serve sftp --auth-proxy because the generateCacheKey cache key omits the authentication method. Attackers knowing a victim's base64 public key can submit it as a password from the same client IP to reuse the cached entry and gain read-write VFS access.

items.title: CVE-2026-134318
items.summary: better-auth 1.5.5 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the organization plugin, where the creator role check compares the raw invitation role string while later checks trim it. Admins or other non-creator roles that can invite can submit a padded role such as " owner" that becomes owner on acceptance, allowing deletion of the organization and removal of original owners.

items.title: CVE-2026-134253
items.summary: Grav API plugin from 1.0.0 before 1.1.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows publishers with media and page write rights to write theme template files through the blueprint-upload endpoint. Attackers can upload a file into a theme's Twig templates folder and include it from sandboxed page Twig to execute commands as the web-server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-134287
items.summary: OpenRemote core before 1.34.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in UserAssetProvisioningMQTTHandler that allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate provisioned devices without proof of private key possession. Attackers can publish a known device's public certificate to the provisioning request topic, authenticating their anonymous MQTT connection as the device's service account to read and modify assets.

items.title: CVE-2026-134249
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain Administrator role by spoofing X-Forwarded-For through a loopback-trusted reverse proxy. Attackers can send requests with Host set to localhost and X-Forwarded-For set to 127.0.0.1 to read private note-history contents via the /history/*path route when no lock-screen password is set.

items.title: CVE-2026-134349
items.summary: Rclone from 1.46.0 before 1.76.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the remote control server that allows unauthenticated clients to crash rclone by sending oversized JSON bodies. Attackers can POST large JSON payloads to protected RC methods, which handlePost decodes before authorization checks, triggering out-of-memory termination and interrupting transfers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134348
items.summary: Rclone from 1.56.0 before 1.76.0 contains a timing side-channel vulnerability in its htpasswd authentication middleware that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate valid usernames. Attackers can send HTTP Basic Auth requests with wrong passwords and measure response times, because bcrypt verification runs only for existing users, enabling targeted password guessing.

items.title: CVE-2026-134347
items.summary: actix-files before 0.7.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read hidden files by requesting Windows 8.3 short-name aliases. Attackers can request short names like ENV~1 or GIT~1/config to bypass the leading-dot check in actix_files::Files and retrieve .env secrets and .git contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-134341
items.summary: actix-http 3.0.0 before 3.20.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to exhaust memory by sending large-window brotli request bodies. Attackers can send an 850-byte body with Content-Encoding: br declaring a 2^30 window, forcing about 1 GiB of decoder allocation per request and OOM-killing servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134325
items.summary: ArcadeDB before 26.11.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the Redis protocol handler, which neither replies to nor closes a pre-authentication connection when it receives an array whose first element is not a string. Unauthenticated attackers can resend such an array just within the 30-second socket idle timeout to hold connections open indefinitely and exhaust RedisNetworkExecutor threads.

items.title: CVE-2026-134314
items.summary: better-auth 1.3.7 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains a race condition in the emailOTP plugin attempt counter, collision-prone email change code keys, and accent-insensitive email lookups. Unauthenticated attackers can send concurrent guesses exceeding allowedAttempts to brute-force OTPs and sign in or reset passwords, signed-in users can verify addresses they do not own, and attackers receiving mail at accent-variant addresses can reset victims' passwords.

items.title: CVE-2026-133250
items.summary: @fastify/middie is the middleware engine for the Fastify web framework. In versions up to and including 9.3.7, middie matches path-scoped middleware against its own reading of the request path, which can differ from the path Fastify's router uses to dispatch the request. When the two disagree, the router can route a request to a handler covered by a middleware mount while middie skips that middleware, so an unauthenticated client reaches a handler that an authentication, authorization, or rate-limiting middleware was meant to protect, with no special configuration required. The mismatch is tri…

items.title: CVE-2026-134259
items.summary: Admidio from 5.0.16 before 5.0.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with folder upload rights to store JavaScript by uploading SVG files served inline. Attackers can upload a script-bearing SVG that downloadFile() serves as image/svg+xml inline without nosniff or CSP, executing on the Admidio origin for viewers including unauthenticated visitors.

items.title: CVE-2026-134245
items.summary: SiYuan 3.8.0 before 3.8.10 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the serveAssets route that allows unauthenticated attackers to read password-protected document assets via name collisions. Attackers can request GET /assets/ when a visible document references the same relative asset name, retrieving the protected file's contents on public-publish instances with Basic Auth disabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-134244
items.summary: SiYuan 3.8.0 before 3.8.10 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in LAN sync that allows adjacent unauthenticated attackers to obtain device metadata by advertising a counterfeit peer with a replayed discovery tag. The client sends the sync scope ID, device name, OS, app version, and TLS client certificate to /peer-sync/v1/session/open before validating the server proof.

items.title: CVE-2026-124626
items.summary: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions 4.0.5 through 4.0.9, the plugin matches path-scoped Express middleware with a matcher that requires a non-empty value for a dynamic segment, while Fastify's router accepts an empty parameter or wildcard value. When a route and an Express middleware mount share a dynamic pattern, a request with an empty segment matches the Fastify route and runs the handler while the middleware mounted on that pattern is skipped, so on a scoped mount an unauthenticated request can reach a pro…

items.title: CVE-2026-134378
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 12.7.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 stores imported Italian supplier e-invoices as public files in the Regional module, which the server returns without authentication. Unauthenticated attackers can request predictable file URLs built from the supplier's VAT number and invoice sequence to read supplier names, VAT numbers, bank account details and line items.

items.title: CVE-2026-133273
items.summary: @fastify/swagger-ui is the plugin that serves Swagger UI documentation for Fastify applications. In versions 2.1.0 through 6.1.4, the authentication hooks that applications register to protect the documentation are applied to every route the plugin adds except the bundled static asset instance. When the option that serves bundled UI files from a local directory is enabled, that instance exposes every file in the directory without credentials, so a specification file an operator meant to keep behind the documentation login becomes reachable by an unauthenticated client who knows or guesses its…

items.summary: SurrealDB 3.0.4 before 4.0.0 does not apply operator-configured WebSocket frame, message, and buffer size limits to the GraphQL WebSocket upgrade handler at GET /graphql, falling back to permissive library defaults. items.title: CVE-2026-134700
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows scene commands to reference PROTO sub-graph nodes freed by a scene replace command. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that causes gf_node_get_field() and gf_node_unregister() to access freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134688
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the BT/XMT context loader that frees an interaction-type decoder-specific descriptor even when UIConfig re-encoding fails. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a BIFSConfig descriptor, causing gf_odf_delete_descriptor() to reuse and free it again, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134684
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that leaves freed node URL fields in the pending object descriptor link list after SFNode replacement. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that reassigns a single-node field, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing the process and potentially corrupting the heap.

items.title: CVE-2026-134677
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory via stale object descriptor links. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene where xmt_node_end() frees a subtree containing InputSensor MFURL fields, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory and crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134671
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted XMT files. Attackers can persuade a user to process an XMT file whose discarded out-of-scope nodes cause gf_node_unregister() to dereference a freed child, crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134668
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory when xmt_node_end() discards an out-of-scope node without resetting command-buffer state. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that leaves parser->command_buffer and parser->command dangling, causing later parsing to access freed memory and crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134666
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader because xmt_node_end() frees unattached nodes but leaves them on the parser node stack. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose text content makes xmt_text_content() pass the freed node to gf_node_get_tag(), reading freed heap memory and crashing MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134665
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory by supplying a crafted XMT file. When xmt_parse_element() replaces an SFNode field child, the freed node stays cached in parser->peeked_nodes and a later DEF lookup passes it to gf_node_get_name(), crashing MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134663
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that retains a pointer to a PROTO sub-graph freed by gf_sg_proto_del(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file imported with MP4Box, causing xmt_parse_command() to update the freed graph's referencing_commands list and crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134662
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a double free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that leaves a stale GF_Command pointer in a Conditional node's SFCommandBuffer when the buffer element is not properly closed. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file with malformed nesting, causing gf_sg_sfcommand_del() to free the live command, corrupting heap memory and crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134284
items.summary: Vikunja from 1.0.0 before 2.8.0 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows attackers to hijack SSO identities by planting local accounts with unverified victim emails. When emailfallback is enabled, attackers register or edit a local account using the victim's email, causing the victim's first OIDC login to link into the attacker-controlled account and expose their data.

items.title: CVE-2026-134262
items.summary: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows role administrators to inject JavaScript by placing quote-breaking payloads in role names rendered unencoded in the data-message attribute in modules/profile/roles_functions.php. Attackers can execute scripts when a full administrator views an affected profile page, stealing the CSRF token to assign themselves the Administrator role.

items.title: CVE-2026-134312
items.summary: Better Auth 0.4.9 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an OAuth sign-in authentication flaw that treats unverified provider emails as verified, including string "false" email_verified claims, unchecked generic OAuth profile/ID-token subject mismatches, and ignored Zoom provider options. Attackers holding a victim's address unverified at an affected provider can sign in, link to the victim's local account, and obtain its session.

items.title: CVE-2026-121810: F5 NGINX Plus remote denial of service in HTTP/3 module (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source are affected when they use HTTP/3. A remote attacker without logging in can trigger a use-after-free in the worker process, causing a restart and denial of service, and under certain conditions may be able to run code, though exploitation depends on factors outside the attacker's control.

items.title: CVE-2026-123007: F5 NGINX Plus memory corruption in HTTP/2 module via integer underflow (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. F5's NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source are affected when they use HTTP/2. A remote attacker who can reach the server without logging in can crash an NGINX worker process or corrupt its memory, and may be able to execute code, but only if Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) is disabled or the attacker can bypass it.

items.title: CVE-2026-123633: F5 NGINX Open Source memory corruption in HTTP/2 module (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. NGINX Open Source and NGINX Plus are affected when configured to use HTTP/2 for client connections and proxy those requests to a backend. Remote attackers can reach the flaw over the network without logging in, using a specially crafted request that can crash the worker process or, on systems with ASLR disabled or bypassed, allow code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-33526: Squid denial of service in ICP request handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Squid, a caching proxy for the Web, has a use-after-free flaw in how it handles ICP traffic. A remote attacker can use it to cause a reliable, repeatable denial of service without logging in, but only on deployments that explicitly enable ICP support by setting a non-zero `icp_port`. Blocking ICP queries with `icp_access` rules does not prevent the attack.

items.title: CVE-2026-105394
items.summary: The Asset CleanUp: Page Speed Booster WordPress plugin before 1.4.0.7 does not restrict which origins it reflects into its cross-origin resource sharing response headers and pairs the reflected origin with credentialed access, allowing a page on a related origin to read a logged-in user's authenticated content across origins.

items.title: CVE-2026-134616
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /deleteClient.php. Such manipulation of the argument client_id leads to sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134572
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /deleteAgent.php. The manipulation of the argument agent_id leads to sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134667
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in xmt_resolve_od_links() that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory via over-long object descriptor URL fragments. Attackers can craft an XMT scene file whose URL fragment overflows the fixed 5000-byte szURL buffer via sprintf, crashing MP4Box when a user loads it.

items.title: CVE-2026-134675
items.summary: Servas before 1.2.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify and delete other users' data by supplying target resource ids. Attackers can abuse TagController update and destroy, LinkController destroy, and GroupController destroy actions to rename or delete tags and delete links and groups.

items.title: CVE-2026-134659
items.summary: OpenAirInterface CN5G AMF before 2.2.2 contains a missing resource release vulnerability in amf_sbi::handle_itti_message() that leaves stale PDU session contexts when NRF lookup or SMF selection fails. Authenticated UEs can request PDU sessions while no SMF is selectable, causing deregistration to wait on SMF release timeouts and stall shared NAS processing for other UEs.

items.title: CVE-2026-134658
items.summary: free5GC SMF through 1.4.6 contains a missing resource release vulnerability in HandlePDUSessionSMContextCreate that leaves CHF charging sessions open when PCF session rule application fails. Attackers can repeatedly trigger failed PDU session establishments to accumulate orphaned charging sessions on the CHF and degrade its availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-134656
items.summary: OpenAirInterface CN5G SMF through 2.2.2 contains a missing resource release vulnerability in handle_pdu_session_release_sm_context_request() that fails to delete N7 SM policy associations at the PCF. Authenticated UEs can repeatedly establish and release PDU sessions through the AMF-initiated Release SM Context path to accumulate stale associations and exhaust PCF memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134655
items.summary: Open5GS AMF through 2.8.0 contains a missing resource release vulnerability that allows authenticated UEs to orphan SMF sessions by triggering Create SM Context response processing failures. Attackers can repeatedly release the RAN UE context while responses are pending, causing AMF_SESS_CLEAR() without Release SM Context requests and degrading SMF availability.

items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file addPayment.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument client_id can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in itsourcecode Banking Management System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file /manage_request.php. items.title: CVE-2026-134567
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in itsourcecode Document Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /showlist.php. The manipulation of the argument condition results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134566
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in itsourcecode Document Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /edit.php. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134704
items.summary: OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle __reduce__ gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-134703
items.summary: libexpat through 2.10.0 contains an improper Unicode handling vulnerability in DEFINE_UTF16_TO_UTF16 conversion functions in xmltok.c that can split valid surrogate pairs when output space is limited. In XML_UNICODE builds parsing non-native byte order UTF-16 input, attackers can supply crafted documents that deliver lone high surrogates to character data and default handlers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134702
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in curve2d_check_changes() that casts a Curve2D point field node to M_Coordinate2D without type checking. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BIFS scene placing another node type such as LinearGradient in that field, causing an invalid pointer read that crashes the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134701
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that leaves freed child node MFURL fields in the OD link list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with an extra top-level SceneReplace node, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

items.title: CVE-2026-134699
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_text.c that allows heap out-of-bounds reads by casting a Text node's fontStyle field to M_FontStyle unchecked. Attackers can craft an XMT/BIFS scene placing a smaller node like Face in fontStyle, causing build_text to read past the allocation and crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134698
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in ctxload_process() in src/filters/load_bt_xmt.c that casts object descriptor update entries without checking the descriptor tag. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BT scene placing a different descriptor type in a GF_ODUpdate command, causing gf_list_get() to dereference an invalid pointer and crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134697
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() that allows attackers to crash the application via indexed field-replace commands lacking a payload. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose GF_SG_XREPLACE command on an MFNode field carries no value, causing a crash and denial of service when opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-134696
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_del that allows attackers to free PROTOs still owned by another scene command via the GF_SG_PROTO_DELETE handler. Attackers can craft an XMT scene that declares a PROTO in one command and deletes it by ID in another, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory when opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-134695
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in avi_parse_input_file() in src/media_tools/avilib.c that increments track counters before checking AVI_MAX_TRACKS. Attackers can supply a crafted AVI file declaring a ninth audio stream, causing AVI_audio_format and AVI_close() to access track[8] and crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134694
items.summary: Gammapy through 2.1 contains a code injection vulnerability in WcsGeom.from_header() that passes the WCSSHAPE FITS header card to eval(). Attackers can supply a crafted .fits file with a Python expression in WCSSHAPE, executing code as the user who loads it via Map.read().

items.title: CVE-2026-134693
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_create_node() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c when cloning PROTO instances. Attackers can craft an XMT scene declaring more PROTO interface fields than the cloned instance supplies, crashing MP4Box when a user opens the file.

items.title: CVE-2026-134692
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability because xmt_find_node() in loader_xmt.c resolves DEF names without verifying the node belongs to the current scene graph. Attackers can craft an XMT scene reusing a PROTO node across graphs, causing gf_node_unregister() to read freed memory during teardown, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134691
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in gf_event_target_get_node() because destroyed node event targets remain in media object lists. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nodes such as InputSensor to trigger freed memory reads during gf_scene_disconnect(), crashing the process or corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134690
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by supplying a crafted XMT scene. Attackers can modify InputSensor, Layout or EnvironmentTest nodes during parsing, triggering compositor handlers that read uninitialized private stacks and cause denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134689
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in JSScript_LoadVRML() in src/scenegraph/vrml_js.c that reads unchecked script_text pointers of Script node url entries. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene loading a Script node whose url entry lacks script text, crashing MP4Box and causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134687
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c when handling MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with an MFNode field replace command lacking a node value to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134686
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c that misinterprets single node values as child lists for MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that causes an invalid node pointer to be dereferenced by gf_node_register(), crashing MP4Box for denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134685
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in load_xmt_done() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that reads freed nodes during XMT parser teardown. Attackers can craft an XMT scene with a scene replace command that destroys PROTO sub-graphs, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory when opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-134683
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt_remove_od_links_recursive() in loader_xmt.c that lacks any depth limit when walking node children. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with deeply nested or cyclic node and SFCommandBuffer references to exhaust the stack and crash MP4Box on import.

items.title: CVE-2026-134682
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in scene graph teardown that allows attackers to trigger access to freed memory via crafted scene files. A node shared across multiple PROTO node_code lists is freed by gf_sg_reset(), and gf_sg_proto_del() then calls gf_node_unregister() on the dangling pointer, crashing MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134681
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_instantiate() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c that lacks cycle detection or depth limits. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose PROTO body instantiates itself directly or indirectly, exhausting the stack and crashing MP4Box when imported.

items.title: CVE-2026-134680
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in TraverseForm() in src/compositor/mpeg4_form.c due to an off-by-one groupsIndex bounds check. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a Form node having constraints but an empty groupsIndex field to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134678
items.summary: Freedit before 0.9.9 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the edit_post_post handler for POST /post/edit/:pid that skips ownership and status checks when a Private inn is submitted. Members of a Private inn can overwrite any post by sequential id, including moderator-locked posts, re-attributing it to themselves and destroying original content.

items.title: CVE-2026-134676
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in gf_odm_disconnect() in src/compositor/object_manager.c caused by a deferred scene_ns_remove_object task holding a raw object manager pointer. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose commands delete a Background2D node, freeing the object manager early to crash the process and corrupt heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134674
items.summary: Freedit before 0.9.9 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the post_lock, post_hide, post_pin and comment_hide handlers that allows inn moderators to act on content from other inns. Attackers can supply their own inn id with a foreign post or comment id to lock or hide content instance-wide, or pin private posts to expose titles.

items.title: CVE-2026-134673
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_resolve_od_links() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to read freed heap memory via stale strstr() pointers. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose MFURL field contains an entry without a URL string, causing sprintf() to read freed memory and crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134672
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt_discard_subtree() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to exhaust the call stack. Attackers can persuade a user to process a crafted XMT file with deeply nested discarded SFNode and MFNode fields to crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134670
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that writes to freed heap memory when replacing single-node field commands. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file where a Conditional node owning the command is unregistered, corrupting heap memory and crashing MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134669
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in gf_xml_sax_peek_node() in src/utils/xml_parser.c that lets attackers read past the heap line buffer. Attackers can craft an XMT file whose ROUTE or command references a later-defined node, crashing MP4Box when a user imports it.

items.title: CVE-2026-134664
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_sensors.c that allows attackers to crash the process via uninitialized sensor nodes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that makes compositor_mpeg4_get_sensor_handler_ex() call hs->IsEnabled through a near-NULL pointer, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134661
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_odf_encode_ui_config() in src/odf/descriptors.c that allows attackers to crash the process. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file declaring an interaction stream without a UIConfig descriptor, causing a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134660
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in xmt_parse_command() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that casts target nodes to GF_ParentNode without validation. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT-A file whose command targets a non-grouping node, causing gf_node_list_get_child() to perform an invalid memory read and crash MP4Box.

items.title: CVE-2026-134657
items.summary: OpenAirInterface CN5G PCF through 2.2.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in pcf_smpc::delete_sm_policy_handler() that leaves stale UE IPv4, SUPI and DNN index entries after association deletion. Attackers can trigger repeated SM policy create and delete cycles over N7 via PDU session establishment and release to grow PCF memory without bound and break association lookups.

items.title: CVE-2026-94259
items.summary: The SMS Alert WordPress plugin before 4.0.4 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, leading to SQL injection exploitable by administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-14233
items.summary: The LifterLMS WordPress plugin before 10.0.5 does not perform a capability or nonce check in one of its quiz-question query AJAX handlers, allowing any authenticated user with subscriber-level access to enumerate the titles of all published quiz questions, including those for courses they are not enrolled in.

items.title: CVE-2026-133362
items.summary: The ThinkRank SEO WordPress plugin before 2.21.4 does not ensure that the settings section a request acts on is the section it was authorized for, allowing users granted access to only one ThinkRank SEO WordPress plugin before 2.21.4 section by an administrator to read and update settings of other, more privileged sections, such as integration API keys and robots.txt content.

items.title: CVE-2026-107593
items.summary: The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 does not perform a capability check on one of its AJAX actions and protects it only with a nonce that it outputs to every authenticated user on all admin pages, allowing any logged-in user, including Subscribers, to trigger a site-wide rewrite of stored book purchase links and change a related Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 option.

items.title: CVE-2026-107592
items.summary: The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 does not perform any capability or nonce check in one of its AJAX actions, allowing any authenticated user with a minimal role such as Subscriber to change the publisher assigned to any book, including books created by other users, and to create new book records. The missing nonce check also makes the action exploitable via CSRF against any logged-in user.

items.title: CVE-2026-134568
items.summary: A flaw has been found in itsourcecode E-Logbook with Health Monitoring System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file log_keeper.php. This manipulation of the argument pid causes sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-134623
items.summary: A flaw has been found in Microweber up to 2.0.20. This impacts the function UserManager::make_logged of the file src/MicroweberPackages/App/Http/Controllers/ApiController.php of the component Generic API Dispatcher. This manipulation causes improper access controls. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.0.21 will fix this issue. Patch name: e639d26e61b989b100f8b6f6bb78c0cecca79b99. You should upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-134553
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in wiroai Wiro-MCP up to 1.3.0. This affects the function upload_file of the file src/tools/upload-file.ts of the component File Upload. This manipulation of the argument url causes server-side request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. Upgrading to version 1.3.1 is able to mitigate this issue. items.title: CVE-2026-134450
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a clickjacking vulnerability because src/hooks.server.ts never sets X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors headers on responses. Attackers on a same-site origin can embed the UI in an invisible iframe to trick authenticated users into stopping stacks, deleting resources, or changing settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-134448
items.summary: Finsys Dockhand 1.0.7 before 1.0.57 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows low-privileged users to read and write arbitrary files by setting an unvalidated envPath on a stack source. Attackers with stacks:edit permission can point envPath to files like /etc/shadow or SSH keys, then use GET or PUT on /api/stacks/[name]/env/raw to read or overwrite them.

items.title: CVE-2026-134536
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in Drakeling Labs Operation Harsh Doorstop up to 0.14.2.1 Build 19523588. The impacted element is the function LaunchURL of the component Workshop Configuration. This manipulation causes unrestricted upload. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 0.14.2.2 Build 26092794 is sufficient to resolve this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

items.title: CVE-2026-134389
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 6.18.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Payment Requests that lets authenticated Accounts User role holders read source documents they lack permission to access. Attackers can create a Payment Request through the generic record interface that references another company's document, then email its loaded content to an address they choose.

items.title: CVE-2026-134387
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 12.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module dashboard chart source that returns account balance history without checking chart or account permissions. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming any account to read general ledger balance history of any company.

items.title: CVE-2026-134367
items.summary: pypdf 2.4.2 before 7.0.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in its handling of XFA forms that allows attackers to cause excessive memory consumption. Attackers can supply a crafted PDF containing XFA forms with many small fields so that loading the forms consumes large amounts of memory, causing a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134006

items.summary: pypdf before 7.0.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to cause large memory usage by supplying crafted PDF cross-reference streams. Attackers can craft a PDF whose cross-reference stream offsets all point to one large object, exhausting memory in applications parsing the file.

items.title: CVE-2026-134355
items.summary: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the /api/station/{station_id}/profile/edit endpoint that exposes and accepts Icecast/Shoutcast passwords for users holding Manage Station Profile without Manage Station Broadcasting. Authenticated station users can read the admin, source, relay and streamer passwords via GET to administer Icecast or broadcast to listeners, or overwrite them via PUT to lock out operators.

items.title: CVE-2026-134335
items.summary: ArcadeDB 21.10.1 before 26.11.1 contains a resource-limit bypass vulnerability that allows restricted users to evade per-group readTimeout because limits are applied to shared cached statements and plans. Attackers can run SQL text previously cached by an unrestricted principal to skip timeouts, or impose their own timeout and limit on root and other users.

items.title: CVE-2026-133988
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Chaterm up to 0.12.2 on Windows. The affected element is an unknown function of the file resources/app-update.yml of the component Auto-Update Mechanism. Such manipulation leads to download of code without integrity check. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. This attack is characterized by high complexity. The exploitability is described as difficult. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-133993
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. This affects the function FUN_0040efb0 of the file gena.cgi of the component GENA Subscription Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument service results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-134273
items.summary: Vikunja from 2.6.0 before 2.8.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the Planka migration converter that multiplies task allocations for duplicate list IDs. Attackers controlling a Planka server can return boards with duplicate list IDs and many cards to exhaust memory and OOM-kill the Vikunja process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134269
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.18.0 before 2.8.0 contains a resource amplification vulnerability in pkg/models/export.go that allows authenticated users to exhaust server memory by exporting heavily related tasks. Attackers can relate many tasks to one task with a large description and request a user export, causing an out-of-memory crash for all users.

items.title: CVE-2026-134268
items.summary: Vikunja from 0.21.0 before 2.8.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows authenticated users to trigger instance-wide database writes by setting a project position below 0.1. Attackers can repeatedly send PUT requests to /api/v2/projects/{id} so recalculateProjectPositions updates every user's root projects, holding SQLite's write lock and degrading availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-134457
items.summary: Hysteria 2.5.0 before 2.8.2 contains a memory allocation vulnerability when sniffing is enabled, allowing authenticated users to trigger out-of-memory conditions. Attackers with a valid password can forward a crafted QUIC packet with a huge crypto length, causing the server to exhaust memory and crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-134456
items.summary: Hysteria 2.5.0 before 2.9.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the HTTP sniff implementation that fails to limit header size. Attackers can continuously send excessively large HTTP headers without terminating them, exhausting server memory and causing out-of-memory crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-134455
items.summary: Hysteria 1.0.0 before 2.9.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in FragUDPMessage where UDP fragmentation fails to handle headers larger than the maximum datagram payload size. Authenticated clients can advertise a small max_datagram_frame_size and trigger a UDP response, causing a slice bounds panic that crashes the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-134454
items.summary: Hysteria from 2.0.0 before 2.9.2 contains an ACL bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated clients to reach blocked UDP destinations by reusing an established UDP session. Attackers can open a session to an allowed destination, then send later packets to localhost or private-network addresses to access internal-only UDP services.

items.title: CVE-2026-134453
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.50 contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows authenticated unprivileged users to read restricted data by querying API endpoints lacking RBAC checks. Attackers can access /api/users, /api/license, and /api/hawser/connect to obtain user emails and roles, the full license key, and environment details, while an invalid license grants all users admin rights.

items.title: CVE-2026-134449
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to perform state-changing actions by exploiting missing Origin header validation and absent CSRF tokens. Attackers can lure authenticated users to a same-site attacker page that submits forged POST requests to stop, start, or delete stacks, modify settings, and change credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-134436

Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can supply document types and filter conditions to read business document line details and probe record values.

items.title: CVE-2026-134435
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that records bank clearance dates, which checks only a broad role permission before writing to caller-named payment documents. Authenticated Accounts Users can send crafted requests naming payment documents of other companies, outside their User Permissions, or already submitted, to alter clearance dates and compromise bank reconciliation integrity.

items.title: CVE-2026-134434
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 16.0.0 before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Manufacturing module endpoint that allows authenticated users to cancel Stock Reservation Entries without record-level write permission. Low-privilege attackers can send crafted requests naming manufacturing documents of other companies or outside their User Permissions to release reserved stock and disrupt stock allocation.

items.title: CVE-2026-134433
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.53.0 fails to enforce record-level authorization in several endpoints, reports and forms, allowing authenticated low-privilege users to access data beyond their role. Attackers can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other companies' financial, stock, pricing and contact data or make constrained changes to those records.

items.title: CVE-2026-134432
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module import endpoint that does not check whether the caller may create inserted records or download a named file. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted import requests to read file contents and create Serial No and Batch records.

items.title: CVE-2026-134431

Authenticated low-privilege users can send crafted requests whose sort parameter holds SQL that the database executes as part of the query, extracting sensitive information.

items.title: CVE-2026-134430

Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read those private files.

items.title: CVE-2026-134429

items.title: CVE-2026-134428

items.title: CVE-2026-133120
items.summary: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. In versions before 4.0.10, the plugin passes Express a request URL that does not always match the path Fastify's router dispatched, so path-scoped Express middleware can be skipped while the route handler still runs. Several request forms trigger the mismatch, including percent-decoding that rewrites a backslash to a slash or double-decodes an encoded percent sign, and a request target that begins with an asterisk, so the middleware and the handler disagree on the path or on parameter a…

items.title: CVE-2026-134411
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 11.1.7 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Regional module endpoint that returns private e-invoice files after checking only document-type permissions, not per-record User Permissions. items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that returns Serial No and Batch ledger entries without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. items.title: CVE-2026-134409
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Projects module endpoint that returns employee costing and billing rates without record-level permission checks. Authenticated users, including portal users or users without roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other employees' activity cost rates.

items.title: CVE-2026-134408
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 16.0.1 before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock dashboard chart endpoint that returns site-wide stock value when the caller has no permitted warehouse. Authenticated users with common operational roles can send crafted requests naming records outside their scope to read stock value data beyond their permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134406
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.94.2 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in a supplier portal endpoint whose party identity check ignores party type, failing to distinguish a Customer and a Supplier that share a name. items.title: CVE-2026-134404

items.title: CVE-2026-134403
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 7.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the customer portal Projects list, which returns every field without checking permission on the requested records. items.title: CVE-2026-134400
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.49.0 before 14.0.0, 14.17.2 before 15.124.0, and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that returns Sales Order line items without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. items.title: CVE-2026-134398
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.87.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that changes Period Closing Voucher job status without permission checks and accepts a request method triggerable cross-site. Authenticated users without an Accounts role, or cross-site pages opened by authenticated users, can send requests naming a scheduled job to stop accounting jobs from completing.

items.title: CVE-2026-134397
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 15.10.4 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that checks whether an inventory number exists and creates missing Serial No and Batch master records without verifying create permission. Authenticated users can send a crafted request with a new number to create these records outside their role, affecting inventory data integrity.

items.title: CVE-2026-134396
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that reconciles Bank Transactions against caller-named vouchers, checking permission only on the Bank Transaction and not on each voucher. Authenticated users with the Accounts User role who can edit a Bank Transaction can send crafted requests naming vouchers outside their permitted scope to change the reconciliation state of vouchers belonging to other companies or outside their User Permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134395
items.summary: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Bank Transaction amounts and bank accounts without checking whether the caller may read the requested records.
